key_insight: PerceptRL makes fine-grained visual perception rewardable by converting verified caption errors into labeled questions and supervising spatial fidelity during tool-assisted inspection.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a post-training recipe for improving multimodal models’ visual accuracy and reducing error propagation from incorrect crops or annotations.
method: Extract and verify caption errors with a multi-agent pipeline, then build chain and multiple-choice QA with rule-based rewards.
Train through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL.
Use Coordinate Injection in cold-start trajectories and grounding-aware process rewards to improve spatial tool use.
evidence_signal: Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, exceeding the base model with the same tools by 15.7 percentage points and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 5.2 points.
watch_item: Implementation depends on reliable error verification and spatial supervision; the abstract does not report their cost or robustness across new domains.
paper_title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
